Same pair, so mutation on the leader again. There is one confound I need to remove before I build anything further on this scaffold. The jump from jnk3 0.10 to 0.14 came with two changes at once: the azine went from pyrimidin-2-yl to pyridin-2-yl, and a fluorine appeared ortho to the arylamine. I do not know which of the two did the work, and that matters a lot for how I spend the rest of the budget - if the fluorine is carrying it I should be decorating halogens, and if the pyridine is carrying it I should be varying the azine. Atom 15 is the aromatic carbon bearing the fluorine at atom 16, a non-ring bond, so removing that branch isolates the question in one modification. It should also be a good molecule in its own right: N-[4-(pyridin-2-ylamino)phenyl]acetamide at 227 Da, LogP down near 2.5 and SA under 1.8, so if activity holds then QED and SA both improve and Phi goes up.
